utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still around and happy to jump in—just point me to the remaining repair jobs and I’ll help match folks up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — I’m tracking the supplies, so I’ll point you to what still needs matching up. We could use help sorting the remaining repair items and checking what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I can sort the remaining repair items and help check what’s missing.

utterances.text: Opal: I still don’t have the repair-drive location confirmed yet, Tess. If you know where it’s being held, I can keep track of it for us.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I don’t have the location confirmed yet either, but I’ll keep my ears open and pass it along as soon as I hear. Folks are still saying screws, duct tape, and a couple flashlights are the big needs right now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep tracking it too, and I’ll note the supplies in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still keeping an ear out while I’m out running errands. If I catch where the repair drive is being held, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira—I'd appreciate that. I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’m hoping to catch the latest when you know it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can come by Saturday around 10 and help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me — Saturday at 10 by your garage is good. I’ll bring the tools I have and keep an eye out if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’ll be there by the garage at 10 on Saturday. Thanks for bringing the tools — I’ll help sort everything out.

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — I’ll be there Saturday at 10 by the garage and keep my schedule around the kids’ school plans.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it’s been a nice turnout. If anyone needs a tool, I’ve got a few they can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s great, Gus — I can help hand out tools if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep an eye out for anyone who needs something and send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — just a quick update: the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep everything organized and make sure folks know where to bring their requests.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Rosa — that’s great news. I’ll help spread the word and loop in anyone who still needs to be connected.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Jules — I really appreciate it. If anyone has questions, send them my way and I’ll keep everything on track.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send over the repair list with who can handle each task and the timing right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—send it over when you can, and I’ll jump on the next task.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m on it — I’ll send the list shortly so you can get started on the next task.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: What’s the main thing you need from me? I’m a bit light on details, but I can help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: The biggest help would be sorting the repair list and matching folks to the right jobs. If you can, I’d really appreciate you checking which homes still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can sort the repair list and check which homes still need help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know where the repair drive is being held?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m not sure yet, Mina—I’m still waiting on the exact location. Once I know, I’ll let you know, and I can bring any tools I already have.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Eli. If you hear where the repair drive’s being held, let me know right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can help with that—what should I bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — if you can bring any spare tools, screws, or tape, that’d be a big help. I’m a little fuzzy on the full list, so if you’ve got anything handy, I can check what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can bring spare tools, screws, and tape — I’ll check what I have and let you know. If you send the full list, I can help match the rest too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’m still happy to help match folks to the remaining repair jobs if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still bringing the repair drive today, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yes — I’m still bringing it today and I can help match folks to the remaining repair jobs too.

utterances.text: Quinn: We’re fixing up the community shed and a few loose fence panels this Saturday morning. Come by around 10 and I’ll point you to the tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Ira! If you hear anyone interested, send them my way or have them swing by the shed around 10 on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might’ve missed a detail or two; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know where the repair drive is being held? If you do, let me know right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not sure I caught the location—can you remind me? If I hear it, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, Saturday at 10 by your garage still works for me. I’ll bring the tools I have and check for your update if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and let you know if we’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo—if you notice anything we’re missing, please let me know ahead of time so I can plan accordingly.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’ll come by Saturday around 10 and help with the shed and fence panels.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, Saturday at 10 works for me. What should I bring for the shed and fence panels?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mostly just gloves and a drill if you’ve got one — and maybe a tape measure. If I remember anything else, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I still haven’t confirmed the location yet, Rosa, but I’ll keep asking around. Once I know where it’s being held, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus — I appreciate you checking. It’s at the community center on Sunday now, so just send people there once you’ve confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Ah, perfect — community center on Sunday. I’ll pass that along and keep an eye out for anyone who still needs the details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help sort the repair list and match folks to the right jobs. If you know which homes still need a hand, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rey — I can do that. I’ll sort donations and keep a simple list of what comes in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — that would help a lot. Send me the list when you have it, and I’ll start matching people to the jobs.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — who still needs to be looped in, and what should I tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Please loop in Sam and Rosa, and start with the repair list so we can match each task to a person and timing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll loop in Sam and Rosa, and I’ll start matching the repair list to each task and timing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you bring any basic repair supplies like tools, tape, screws, or sturdy boxes? I’d like to match each repair to the right person once we know what’s available.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can bring some tools, tape, and a box of screws. Want me to check if I have any sturdy boxes too?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: What time is the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’m not sure yet — maybe we should check the sign-up or ask at the check-in table. If I hear anything more, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Nell. I’ll check the sign-up or the check-in table and keep my tools handy.
